description: This file defines the SubscriptionPlan controller class for the admin catalog module of OpenCart. It manages CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, copying, and deleting subscription plans, as well as rendering related views.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription plans within the admin catalog section of OpenCart, including CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and batch actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to load the subscription plan management view, sets up breadcrumbs, actions, and page title.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads the list of subscription plans by calling getList and renders the response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares subscription plan data with sorting, pagination, and links, then renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the subscription plan form for creating or editing an existing subscription plan, including language and description data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the POST request to save a new or existing subscription plan, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies selected subscription plans, requires modify permission.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected subscription plans, requires modify permission.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected subscription plans, requires modify permission.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription plans after checking for product associations and permissions.
